Globex will open 40 stores in 2027 and hire about 1,500 store staff.
Globex named regional retailer of the year.

hook.fact: Kim Lee named VP of Retail Operations, leading store staffing for the 2027 openings.

draft.subject: Staffing 40 new Globex stores
draft.body:
Hi Kim,

Congratulations on the new role. Leading store staffing while Globex opens 40 stores and hires about 1,500 people next year is a big first project.

I run sales at Shiftly. We make shift-scheduling software for retail chains, and new stores are usually where scheduling gets hardest: new teams, no history to plan from.

Would it be worth 20 minutes in the next few weeks to compare notes on how you plan to staff the openings?

Best, Mia

report_markdown:
Draft saved to **Kim Lee** (kim@globex.example). Not sent.

It opens on Kim's new role as VP of Retail Operations ([Globex, Nov 2](https://globex.example/news/2026-11-02-kim-lee-vp-retail-operations)) and the 40 stores planned for 2027 ([RetailWire, Oct 28](https://retailwire.example/2026/10/28/globex-40-stores)).

Check before sending: the 20-minute ask, if you'd rather open without one.
